method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: four friends, late 20s, two men and two women
setting_basis: An afternoon in a friend's flat, then a near-empty beach at Karwar in the same afternoon light; Gokarna is only talked about and never shown, and the footage makes no crowd, price or month claim of its own.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_friends
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of four Indian friends in their late twenties standing in a loose row: a lean man with curly black hair in an olive linen shirt and rolled cream trousers; a broad man with a buzz cut in a plain white t-shirt and denim shorts; a woman with long straight hair in a mustard cotton kurta top and white jeans; a woman with a short pixie cut in a black tank top under an open blue striped shirt and khaki shorts; all barefoot or in sandals, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_beach
refs.prompt: A long, wide, near-empty sandy beach in soft afternoon light, gentle surf, a line of casuarina trees behind the sand, low green hills at the far end and a single wooden fishing boat pulled up on the sand, photorealistic, no people, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_s1
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind in a small flat's living room in soft afternoon window light: the four friends sit on the floor on cushions around one phone, its screen only a soft glow, the man in the white t-shirt mid-laugh with an arm round the woman in the striped shirt.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot from the side on the flat's small balcony, same afternoon light as the reference: the man in the olive linen shirt sits apart on the low balcony wall, phone in hand, its screen only a soft glow, looking away over the rooftops; the other three are soft and out of focus through the doorway behind him.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.tone: surprise at how empty it is
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind in soft afternoon light: the four friends walk along the waterline of the long, empty beach in a loose line, small in the frame, the casuarina trees and the lone fishing boat ahead of them.

keyframes.name: kf_s4
keyframes.prompt: Insert on four pairs of bare feet at the edge of the surf, same beach and same afternoon light as the reference, trouser hems rolled up, a thin sheet of foam washing over their toes.

keyframes.name: kf_s5
keyframes.tone: the honest catch, a little wry
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot from behind on the empty beach in soft afternoon light: the man in the olive shirt and the woman in the mustard top sit calmly on the sand facing the sea; behind them the man in the white t-shirt and the woman in the striped shirt stand with hands on hips, looking restlessly down the empty shore.

keyframes.name: kf_s6
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot, high angle from the rocks at the end of the beach in late afternoon light: the long curve of empty sand, the four friends small in the frame sitting in a row near the waterline, the man in the white t-shirt leaning over to nudge the man in the olive shirt.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. They lean in over the phone and laugh.
shots.sound: A ceiling fan turning, quiet room tone, a scooter passing on the street below.

shots.prompt: Slow push-in. He scrolls with his thumb and keeps looking out over the rooftops.
shots.sound: Distant street traffic, a crow calling from a rooftop, a light breeze on the balcony.

shots.prompt: The camera follows slowly behind them along the waterline.
shots.sound: Waves breaking softly on the shore, bare footsteps on wet sand, a light sea breeze.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still as the wave washes in over their feet and draws back.
shots.sound: Foam hissing over wet sand, small waves breaking, open beach tone.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. The two standing shift their weight and look down the shore; the two sitting do not move.
shots.sound: Waves breaking steadily, wind across the open beach, a distant gull.

shots.prompt: Slow drift down toward the sand. He nudges his friend, who shoves him back.
shots.sound: Distant waves rolling in, wind over the rocks, a gull calling.

en: The four of us had Gokarna locked in for December, and nobody wanted to change it.
Nikhil still wanted a beach where we could hear the waves, so he kept looking.
NakshIQ gave him a swap called Karwar, with Gokarna packed in season and Karwar nearly empty.
December was a go for both, so the month was never the question.
But it was honest about the catch: Gokarna is the backpacker party, Karwar a quiet coastal town.

So we went quiet, and the two who wanted a party still bring it up.
Travel intelligence is knowing what the swap costs.
NakshIQ.
hi: हम चारों ने दिसंबर के लिए गोकर्ण पक्का कर रखा था, और कोई बदलना नहीं चाहता था।
निखिल को फिर भी ऐसा बीच चाहिए था जहाँ लहरों की आवाज़ सुनाई दे, तो वो ढूँढता रहा।
NakshIQ ने उसे कारवार सुझाया, सीज़न में गोकर्ण के बीच भरे रहते हैं और कारवार के लगभग खाली।
दिसंबर दोनों जगह के लिए गो था, तो महीना कभी मसला था ही नहीं।
पर उसने कमी भी साफ़ बताई: गोकर्ण बैकपैकर पार्टी है, कारवार एक शांत समुद्री कस्बा।

तो हमने शांति चुनी, और जिन दो को पार्टी चाहिए थी वो आज भी ताना मारते हैं।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है ये जानना कि बदलाव की कीमत क्या है।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: The four of us had Gokarna locked in for December, | and *nobody wanted to change it*.

shot_notes: Four friends in their late 20s, two men and two women, sit on a hostel floor in the afternoon around one phone, seen from behind.
One man sits apart on a low wall, phone in hand, looking out toward the sea, shot from the side.
Afternoon on a wide empty Karwar beach: the four walk along the waterline in a loose line, small in the frame, backs to camera.
Close on bare feet at the edge of the surf as a small wave washes over them.
Two of the friends sit on the sand facing the sea while the other two stand behind them, faces turned away.
Wide shot of the empty beach in late afternoon light, the four small figures far down the shore.
